data.description: The Seating Twister Single is a one-person seated waist twister with an orange seat and a handle wheel. The user sits, holds the wheel and turns the lower body from side to side, a slow movement that loosens the back and waist. It is one of the easiest machines for older users or anyone who cannot stand for long, and it needs very little space. That makes it useful in a small society garden or as an extra station beside a walking track. It is finished in Play Orange. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm the Seating Twister Single's cover in your quote.

items.pText: The Seating Twister Single is a one-person seated waist twister with an orange seat and a handle wheel. The user sits, holds the wheel and turns the lower body from side to side, a slow movement that loosens the back and waist. It is one of the easiest machines for older users or anyone who cannot stand for long, and it needs very little space. That makes it useful in a small society garden or as an extra station beside a walking track. It is finished in Play Orange. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm the Seating Twister Single's cover in your quote.

The rotating seat sits on a bearing that takes the user's weight, so it needs greasing and a check for play at each service. A machine this small is usually installed self-standing on a firm base. Place it where the user can turn freely without knocking a bench or planter.
